newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy files for $500 mln debt offering.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy files for $500 mln debt offering.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $500 million of senior and subordinated debt securities.

It said proceeds would be used to refinance $440.8 million of Series A general term notes, Series A senior deferred common notes, Series B senior deferred coupon note and for general corporate purposes.
The $93.7 million of Series A General Term Notes are due at par from April through December 1997 and carry interest rates from 6.75 to 8.5 percent.

The $172 million of Series A, 9.5 percent senior deferred coupon notes are due October 1, 1997, at par. The $175.1 million of Series B, 9.875 percent senior deferred coupon notes are callable October 1, 1997, at 101.65.
CMS Energy is an international energy company.
